visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white and blue denim-style jacket over a black top and light beige pants, sits on a stool in a bright pantry area. She gestures with her hands as she speaks directly to the camera. Behind her, an 'Equipment Room' door and a water dispenser are visible in a clean, office-like setting. (2) The scene cuts to a mobile phone screen recording, demonstrating the OPENPOINT application. The interface displays various sections like service menus and a map view with icons representing 7-Eleven stores. (3) The shot returns to the woman, now in a closer medium shot, continuing her enthusiastic explanation with active hand movements and changing facial expressions. (4) The screen recording reappears, showing a detailed inventory of discounted food items at specific stores, including icons for lunch boxes, bread, and salads. (5) The woman is shown again holding her smartphone, showing the app to the viewer while smiling. (6) In the final phase, she stands up and runs away from the camera toward the side of the room as colorful variety-style text overlays appear around her.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 每到月底. (2) [Subtitle]: 口袋空空 要省錢又不想餓肚子. (3) [Subtitle]: 教你簡單買到 65 折的 7-11 便當. (4) [Slogan]: 先下載並打開 OPENPOINT 的 App. (5) [Slogan]: 點選下方選單的「服務」. (6) [Slogan]: 再到「i 地圖」選擇「i 珍食」. (7) [Slogan]: 進去後就可以看到附近超商 還剩哪些即期食物. (8) [Slogan]: 裡面的品項通通都是有打折的. (9) [Subtitle]: 假設一個便當要 NT$90 打完折只要 NT$59 就能買到 簡直買到賺到. (10) [Slogan]: 但要注意 65 折的每天只有開放兩個時段. (11) [Slogan]: 分別為早上 10 點到下午 5 點以及晚上 8 點到凌晨 3 點. (12) [Slogan]: 晚上 7 點到 8 點以前的則會是 8 折而已. (13) [Subtitle]: 欸 來看下有什麼好吃的 喔對了 如果你常經過的 7-11 門市 也可以按右上角收藏. (14) [Subtitle]: 它就會出現在最上面 然後如果是你喜歡想要買的東西 也可以按加入追蹤. (15) [Subtitle]: 雖然有 App 輔助 但建議還是要到庫存多一點的門市 才比較不容易撲空喔 先不說了 不要跟我搶 我要去當乞丐超人了. (16) [Variety]: (是要跑多快?) [Variety]: 乞丐超人.
